questions.title: 設x為實數，函數f (x) = 5cosax + bsinax
questions.question_text:
設x為實數，函數f (x) = 5cosax + bsinax + c，其中a，b為正數。若f
(x)的週期為4π，最大 值為48，最小值為8，試求常數a，b，c之值。
questions.explanation_text:
因為f (x) = 5cosax + bsinax + c =$\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}$
($\frac{5}{\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}}$cosax +$\frac{b}{\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}}$sinax) + c =$\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}$sin(ax + θ)，其中sinθ =$\frac{5}{\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}}$，cosθ =$\frac{b}{\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}}$ 依題意得${ \begin{array}{r} \sqrt{25 + b^{2}} + c = 48 \ - \sqrt{25 + b^{2}} + c = 8 \end{array} \right.$
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image4.png] 由① + ②解得c = 28；由① − ②解得$\sqrt{25 + b^{2}}$= 20 ⇒ b =$\sqrt{375}$= 5$\sqrt{15}$ 又y = f (x)週期為4π，故得$\frac{2\pi}{a}$= 4π ⇒ a =$\frac{1}{2}$
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 其中a，b，c為常數，而0 ≤ x ≤ 2π， −$\frac{
questions.question_text: 其中a，b，c為常數，而0 ≤ x ≤ 2π， −$\frac{\pi}{2}$≤ a，b，c ≤ 2π， 求三元數組(a，b，c)。
questions.explanation_text:
將點(0，1)，($\frac{\pi}{2}$，3)及($\frac{3\pi}{2}$，− 1) 代入y = a cos(x + b) + c，可得方程組 ${ \begin{array}{r} a\cos b + c = 1\cdots \ - a\sin b + c = 3 \ a\sin b + c = - 1 \end{array} \right.$[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image6.png]
② + ③得c = 1，再將c = 1代入①及② 得${ \begin{array}{r} a\cos b + c = 1 \ a\sin b = - 2 \end{array} \right.$
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image7.png] 因為a ≠ 0且 −$\frac{\pi}{2}$≤ b ≤ 2π，故知cos b = 0 ∴ b = −$\frac{\pi}{2}$，$\frac{3\pi}{2}$ 再將b = −$\frac{\pi}{2}$及$\frac{3\pi}{2}$代入⑤得a = 2， 故三元數組(a，b，c) =
(2，−$\frac{\pi}{2}$，1)，(2，$\frac{3\pi}{2}$，1)
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 若函數$f(x) = \sqrt{3}\sin 3x - \co
questions.question_text:
若函數$f(x) = \sqrt{3}\sin 3x - \cos 3x + 2$﹐則下列哪些選項是正確的﹖ (1) −2 ≤ f (x) ≤ 2
(2)f (x)在$x = \frac{2\pi}{9}$時有最大值 (3)f
(x)的週期為$\frac{\pi}{3}$ (4)f (1) > 2
(5)y = f (x)的圖形對稱於直線$x = \frac{5\pi}{9}$﹒
questions.explanation_text:
$f(x) = \sqrt{3}\sin 3x - \cos 3x + 2 = 2(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin 3x - \frac{1}{2}\cos 3x) + 2$ $= 2(\sin 3x\cos\frac{\pi}{6} - \cos 3x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}) + 2 = 2\sin(3x - \frac{\pi}{6}) + 2$
(1)╳﹕∵$- 1 \leq \sin(3x - \frac{\pi}{6}) \leq 1$ ∴0 ≤ f (x) ≤ 4
(2)○﹕當$\sin(3x - \frac{\pi}{6}) = 1 = \sin\frac{\pi}{2}$時﹐f
(x)有最大值$\Rightarrow 3x - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow x = \frac{2\pi}{9}$
(3)╳﹕週期為$\frac{2\pi}{3}$
(4)○﹕∵3≒3 × 57° = 171° ∴f (1) = 2sin(3 − 30°) + 2≒2sin141° + 2 > 2
(∵sin141° > 0)
(5)○﹕$x = \frac{5\pi}{9}$代入$f(x) \Rightarrow 3x - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{3} - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{3\pi}{2}$
∵對稱軸經過波峰或波谷 故選(2)(4)(5)﹒
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：其中A為波峰﹐B為波谷且c > 0﹒請問下列何者正確﹖ (1)a
questions.question_text:
其中A為波峰﹐B為波谷且c > 0﹒請問下列何者正確﹖
(1)a^2^ + b^2^ = 2 (2)0 < b − a < 1 (3)c = 3
(4)f (x) = f (x + 2π )恆成立
(5)由y = 2sin(cx)向左平移$\frac{\pi}{3}$可得y = f (x)的圖形﹒
questions.explanation_text:
f (x) = asin(cx) + bcos(cx) =$\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}}\sin(cx + \varphi)$﹐其中﹐$\cos\varphi = \frac{a}{\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}}}$﹐$\sin\varphi = \frac{b}{\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}}}$
(1)╳﹕由圖中資料﹐$\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}} = 2 \Rightarrow a^{2} + b^{2} = 4$
(2)○﹕f (x) = 2sin(3x + φ)﹐令$3 \times \frac{\pi}{18} + \varphi = \frac{\pi}{2}$﹐得$\varphi = \frac{\pi}{3}$ $\sin\varphi - \cos\varphi = \frac{b - a}{\sqrt{a^{2} + b^{2}}}$﹐又$0 < \sin\frac{\pi}{3} - \cos\frac{\pi}{3} < 1$ ∴0 < b − a < 1
(3)○﹕週期$= 2(\frac{7}{18}\pi - \frac{\pi}{18}) = \frac{2\pi}{3}$ ∴c = 3
(4)○﹕$f(x + 2\pi) = f(x + \frac{2\pi}{3} \times 3) = f(x)$
(5)╳﹕$y = 2\sin(3x + \frac{\pi}{3}) = 2\sin(3(x + \frac{\pi}{9}))$ ∴須向左移$\frac{\pi}{9}$ 故選(2)(3)(4)﹒
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 設0 ≤ x ≤ π，f (x) = 3 + cosx − co
questions.question_text:
設0 ≤ x ≤ π，f (x) = 3 + cosx − cos
($\frac{\pi}{3} - x$)，當x = α 時有最大值M，當x = β 時有最小值m， 則 α + β =＿＿＿＿。 M + m =＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text: (1) f (x) = 3 + cosx − cos ($\frac{\pi}{3}$− x) = 3 + cosx − [cos$\frac{\pi}{3}$cosx + sin$\frac{\pi}{3}$sinx] = 3 + ($\frac{1}{2}$cosx −$\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$sinx) = 3 + cos(x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$) 0 ≤ x ≤ π，$\frac{\pi}{3}$≤ x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$≤$\frac{4\pi}{3}$ ⇒ − 1 ≤ cos(x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$) ≤$\frac{1}{2}$ ${ \begin{array}{r} \cos(x + \frac{\pi}{3}) = \frac{1}{2}， 即 x = a = 0 時，有最大值 M = \frac{7}{2} \ \cos(x + \frac{\pi}{3}) = - 1， 即 x = \beta = \frac{2\pi}{3} 時，有最小值 m = 2 \end{array} \right.$ ∴ ${ \begin{array}{r} \alpha + \beta = \frac{2\pi}{3} \ M + m = \frac{11}{2} \end{array} \right.$

questions.title: 隨堂練習：設0 ≤ x ≤ π，若函數f (x) = 4sinx − 2$
questions.question_text: 設0 ≤ x ≤ π，若函數f (x) = 4sinx − 2$\sqrt{3}$sin(x −$\frac{\pi}{6}$)在x = x~1~時有最大值M；在x = x~2~ 時有最小值為m，則數對(x~1~，M) = ＿＿＿＿，(x~2~，m) = ＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
f (x) = 4sinx − 2$\sqrt{3}$sin(x −$\frac{\pi}{6}$) = 4sinx − 2$\sqrt{3}$ (sinx cos$\frac{\pi}{6}$ − cosx sin$\frac{\pi}{6}$) = 4sinx − 2$\sqrt{3}$ ($\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$sinx −$\frac{1}{2}$cosx) = sinx +$\sqrt{3}$cosx = 2($\frac{1}{2}$sinx +$\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$cosx) = 2sin(x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$) 因為0 ≤ x ≤ π，所以$\frac{\pi}{3}$≤ x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$≤$\frac{4\pi}{3}$。因此
①當x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$=$\frac{\pi}{2}$，即x =$\frac{\pi}{6}$時，f
(x)最大值M = 2
②當x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$=$\frac{4\pi}{3}$，即x = π時，f
(x)最小值m = −$\sqrt{3}$

questions.title: 隨堂練習：設f (x) = sin2x + sin($\frac{\pi}
questions.question_text:
設f (x) = sin2x + sin($\frac{\pi}{3}$ − 2x)，下列何者正確？
(A) f (x)之週期為π (B) f
(x)之最大值與最小值之差為2 (C) f
(x)之振幅為2
(D) y = f (x)之圖形可由y = cos2x之圖形右移$\frac{\pi}{6}$而得
(E) y = f (x)之圖形可由y = sin2x之圖形左移$\frac{\pi}{6}$而得。
questions.explanation_text: f (x) = sin2x + sin($\frac{\pi}{3}$− 2x) = sin2x + sin$\frac{\pi}{3}$cos2x − cos$\frac{\pi}{3}$sin2x = sin2x +$\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$cos2x −$\frac{1}{2}$sin2x =$\frac{1}{2}$sin2x +$\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$cos2x = sin2x cos$\frac{\pi}{3}$ + cos2x sin$\frac{\pi}{3}$= sin(2x +$\frac{\pi}{3}$) 故選(A)(B)(E)

questions.title: 設f (x) = 2sin(30° − x) − 2cosx
questions.question_text:
設f (x) = 2sin(30° − x) − 2cosx， − 60° ≤ x ≤ 210°，若f (x)在x = α 處有最大值M， 在x = β 處有最小值m，下列何者正確？(A) M = 2 (B) α = 210° (C) m = − 2 (D) β = 60°
(E) M − m = 4。
questions.explanation_text: f (x) = 2sin(30° − x) − 2cosx = 2sin30° cosx − 2cos30° sinx − 2cosx = − cosx −$\sqrt{3}$sinx = − 2($\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$sinx +$\frac{1}{2}$cosx) = − 2(sinx cos$\frac{\pi}{6}$ + cosx sin$\frac{\pi}{6}$) = − 2sin(x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$)且 − 30° ≤ x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$≤ 240° 故選(B)(C)(D)

questions.title: 隨堂練習：關於函數$y = \sqrt{3}\sin(x + \frac{
questions.question_text:
關於函數$y = \sqrt{3}\sin(x + \frac{\pi}{6}) - 2\sin x$的圖形﹐選出正確的選項﹕ (1)週期為2π
(2)振幅為2 (3)與y軸的交點為(0 , − 1) (4)與x軸有無限多個交點
(5)對稱於直線$x = \frac{\pi}{3}$﹒
questions.explanation_text:
將函數化成正弦函數的形式﹐ 得$y = \sqrt{3}\sin(x + \frac{\pi}{6}) - 2\sin x = \sqrt{3}(\sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6} + \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}) - 2\sin x$ $= \sqrt{3}(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin x + \frac{1}{2}\cos x) - 2\sin x = - \frac{1}{2}\sin x + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cos x = - (\sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{3} - \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{3})$ $= - \sin(x - \frac{\pi}{3})$﹒
因此﹐其圖形可由y = sinx的圖形向右平移$\frac{\pi}{3}$單位﹐ 再以x軸為基準線﹐上下翻轉得到﹐ 如下圖所示﹒
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image10.png]
(1)週期為2π﹒
(2)振幅為1﹒
(3)將x = 0代入函數﹐得$y = - \sin( - \frac{\pi}{3}) = - ( - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$﹐ 因此﹐圖形與y軸的交點為$(0,\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})$﹒
(4)由圖知﹐圖形與x軸有無限多個交點﹒
(5)因為直線$x = \frac{\pi}{3}$不是通過最高點或最低點的鉛直線﹐所以圖形沒有對稱此直線﹒
故選(1)(4)﹒
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：A > 0，0 < θ <$\frac{\pi}{2}$。若x$
questions.question_text:
A > 0，0 < θ <$\frac{\pi}{2}$。若x$\in$R，y有最小值β； 當 −$\frac{\pi}{3}$≤ x ≤$\frac{\pi}{6}$時，y有最大值M，最小值m， 則：(A) A = 2 (B) θ = 30° (C) β = 0
(D) M = 5 (E) m = 3。
questions.explanation_text:
(1) y = f (x) =$\sqrt{3}$cosx − sinx + 2 = 2($\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$cosx −$\frac{1}{2}$sinx) + 2 = 2(cosx cos$\frac{\pi}{6}$− sinx sin$\frac{\pi}{6}$) + 2 = 2cos(x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$) + 2 = Acos(x + θ) + 2，A > 0，0 < θ <$\frac{\pi}{2}$
∴ A = 2，θ =$\frac{\pi}{6}$
(2)若x$\in$R，y有最小值0 （此時cos(x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$) = − 1） ⇒ β = 0
(3)當 −$\frac{\pi}{3}$≤ x ≤$\frac{\pi}{6}$時，−$\frac{\pi}{6}$≤ x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$≤$\frac{\pi}{3}$
⇒ $\frac{1}{2} \leq$cos(x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$) ≤ 1 ⇒ 1$\leq$2cos(x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$) ≤ 2 ⇒ 3 ≤ y ≤ 4
∴ M = 4，m = 3 故選(A)(B)(C)(E)

questions.title: 隨堂練習：有關y = f (x) = 2sin2x − 3cos2x +
questions.question_text:
有關y = f (x) = 2sin2x − 3cos2x + 5之圖形﹐下列敘述何者錯誤﹖
(1)週期= π (2)振幅= 5 (3)與y軸之交點為(0,1) (4)與x軸之交點有無限多個
(5)圖形對稱於x軸﹒
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image12.png]
questions.explanation_text:
$y = 2\sin 2x - 3\cos 2x + 5 = \sqrt{13}(\frac{2}{\sqrt{13}}\sin 2x - \frac{3}{\sqrt{13}}\cos 2x) + 5$ $= \sqrt{13}(\sin 2x \cdot \cos\theta - \cos 2x \cdot \sin\theta) + 5 = \sqrt{13}\sin(2x - \theta) + 5 > 0$ $${\cos\theta = \frac{2}{\sqrt{13}} }{\sin\theta = \frac{3}{\sqrt{13}} }$$(1)○﹕週期為π
(2)╳﹕振幅$\sqrt{13}$
(3)╳﹕令x = 0﹐y = 2﹐與y軸交於(0,2)
(4)╳﹕y值恆正﹐∴與x軸不相交
(5)╳﹕y > 0與x軸不對稱 故選(2)(3)(4)(5)﹒

questions.title: 隨堂練習：10.已知0 ≤ x ≤ π﹐$y = 2\cos(\frac{
questions.question_text:
10.已知0 ≤ x ≤ π﹐$y = 2\cos(\frac{\pi}{3} - x) - 2\cos x + 1$﹐則下列何者正確﹖
(1)y的週期是2π (2)y的最大值 = 3 (3)y的最大值 = 2 (4)y的最小值 = 0
(5)$x = \frac{2\pi}{3}$時﹐y有最大值﹒
questions.explanation_text:
$y = 2\cos(\frac{\pi}{3} - x) - 2\cos x + 1 = 2(\cos\frac{\pi}{3}\cos x + \sin\frac{\pi}{3}\sin x) - 2\cos x + 1$ $= \sqrt{3}\sin x - \cos x + 1 = 2(\sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{6} - \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{6}) + 1 = 2\sin(x - \frac{\pi}{6}) + 1$
∴週期為2π
∵0 ≤ x ≤ π
⇒$- \frac{\pi}{6} \leq x - \frac{\pi}{6} \leq \frac{5\pi}{6} \Rightarrow - \frac{1}{2} \leq \sin(x - \frac{\pi}{6}) \leq 1$
∴$0 \leq y = 2\sin(x - \frac{\pi}{6}) + 1 \leq 3$ 且當y = 3時﹐$x - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow x = \frac{2\pi}{3}$ 故選(1)(2)(4)(5)﹒
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 設f (x) = 2sinxcosx − (sinx + cos
questions.question_text:
設f (x) = 2sinxcosx −
(sinx + cosx)﹐t = sinx + cosx﹐下列敘述何者正確﹖
(1)$t = \sqrt{2}\sin(x + \frac{\pi}{4})$ (2)f
(x) = t^2^ − t − 1 (3)f
(x)有最小值$- \frac{5}{4}$
(4)$\sin x + \cos x = - \sqrt{2}$時﹐f
(x)有最小值 (5)f
(x)有最大值$1 - \sqrt{2}$﹒
questions.explanation_text:
$t = \sin x + \cos x = \sqrt{2}\sin(x + \frac{\pi}{4})$﹐$- \sqrt{2} \leq t \leq \sqrt{2}$
(sinx + cosx)^2^ = sin^2^x + cos^2^x + 2sinxcosx⇒ t^2^ = 1 + 2sinxcosx $$\Rightarrow f(x) = 2\sin x\cos x - (\sin x + \cos x) = t^{2} - 1 - t = t^{2} - t - 1 = (t - \frac{1}{2})^{2} - \frac{5}{4} $$又$- \sqrt{2} \leq t \leq \sqrt{2}$
∴$t = \sin x + \cos x = \frac{1}{2}$時有最小值$- \frac{5}{4}$﹐$t = \sin x + \cos x = - \sqrt{2}$時有最大值$1 + \sqrt{2}$ 故選(1)(2)(3)﹒

questions.title: $\frac{\pi}{12}$≤ θ ≤$\frac{3\pi
questions.question_text: $\frac{\pi}{12}$≤ θ ≤$\frac{3\pi}{4}$且3sin^2^ θ + 4$\sqrt{3}$sinθ cosθ − cos^2^θ = 5，則θ = ＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
3sin^2^θ + 4$\sqrt{3}$sinθ cosθ − cos^2^θ = 5 ⇒ 3($\frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}$) + 2$\sqrt{3}$sin2θ −$\frac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}$= 5
⇒ 2$\sqrt{3}$sin2θ − 2cos2θ = 4 ⇒ $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$sin2θ −$\frac{1}{2}$cos2θ = 1 ⇒ sin(2θ −$\frac{\pi}{6}$) = 1
∴ 2θ −$\frac{\pi}{6}$=$\frac{\pi}{2}$，$\frac{5\pi}{2}$，−$\frac{3\pi}{2}$，...，但$\frac{\pi}{12}$≤ θ ≤$\frac{3\pi}{4}$ ∴ θ =$\frac{\pi}{3}$
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：設$\sqrt{3}$sin2x + 2cos^2^x的最大值為
questions.question_text: 設$\sqrt{3}$sin2x + 2cos^2^x的最大值為M，最小值為m，則M + m = ＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
$\sqrt{3}$sin2x + 2cos^2^x =$\sqrt{3}$sin2x + cos2x + 1 = 2($\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$sin2x +$\frac{1}{2}$cos2x) + 1 = 2(sin2x cos$\frac{\pi}{6}$ + cos2x sin$\frac{\pi}{6}$) + 1 = 2sin(2x +$\frac{\pi}{6}$) + 1
∴ M = 3，m = − 1 ⇒ M + m = 2
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：$\frac{\pi}{12}$≤ θ ≤$\frac{3\pi
questions.question_text:
$\frac{\pi}{12}$≤ θ ≤$\frac{3\pi}{4}$，若f
(θ) = 3sin^2^θ + 4$\sqrt{3}$sinθ cosθ − cos^2^θ可化成asin(2θ − b) + c， 0 < b <$\frac{\pi}{2}$，且當θ = α 時，f
(θ)有最大值β。
則(A) a = 4 (B) b =$\frac{\pi}{6}$ (C) c = 1 (D) α =$\frac{\pi}{3}$ (E) β = 5
questions.explanation_text:
f (θ) = 3sin^2^θ + 4$\sqrt{3}$sinθ cosθ − cos^2^θ = 3($\frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2}$) + 2$\sqrt{3}$sin2θ −$\frac{1 + \cos 2\theta}{2}$ = 2$\sqrt{3}$sin2θ − 2cos2θ + 1 = 4($\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$sin2θ −$\frac{1}{2}$cos2θ) + 1 = 4sin(2θ −$\frac{\pi}{6}$) + 1 = asin(2θ − b) + c
(1)∴ a = 4，b =$\frac{\pi}{6}$，c = 1
(2)但$\frac{\pi}{12}$< θ≤$\frac{3\pi}{4}$ ⇒ $\frac{\pi}{6}$< 2θ ≤$\frac{3\pi}{2}$ ⇒ 0 ≤ 2θ −$\frac{\pi}{6}$≤$\frac{4\pi}{3}$ 當2θ −$\frac{\pi}{6}$=$\frac{\pi}{2}$ ⇒ θ =$\frac{\pi}{3}$時，f
(θ) = 5為最大值 ⇒ α =$\frac{\pi}{3}$，β = 5 故選(A)(B)(C)(D)(E)
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 設0 ≤ x ≤$\frac{\pi}{2}$，f (x) =
questions.question_text:
設0 ≤ x ≤$\frac{\pi}{2}$，f (x) = 2 + 2(sinx + cosx) − sin2x，則sinx + cosx的範圍為＿＿＿＿。若f
(x) 在x = x~1~時有最大值M；在x = x~2~時有最小值為m，則數對(x~1~，M) = ＿＿＿＿，(x~2~，m) = ＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
(1)令t = sinx + cosx，故得 t =$\sqrt{2}$ ($\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$sinx +$\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$cosx) =$\sqrt{2}$ (sinx cos$\frac{\pi}{4}$+ cosx sin$\frac{\pi}{4}$) =$\sqrt{2}$sin(x +$\frac{\pi}{4}$) 因為0 ≤ x ≤$\frac{\pi}{2}$，所以$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$≤ sin(x +$\frac{\pi}{4}$) ≤ 1，故1 ≤ t ≤$\sqrt{2}$
(2)將t = sinx + cosx兩邊平方後整理，得sinx cosx =$\frac{t^{2} - 1}{2}$ 因為f (x) = 2 + 2(sinx + cosx) − 2sinx cosx 故將f (x)中的sinx + cosx及sinx cosx分別用t及$\frac{t^{2} - 1}{2}$代換後， 我們把f (x)用t所表的函數記為g (t)，則 g (t) = 2 + 2t − (t^2^ − 1) = − (t^2^ − 2t + 1) + 4 = − (t − 1)^2^ + 4，其中 −$\sqrt{2}$≤ t ≤$\sqrt{2}$
①當t = 1時，此時可解出x = 0或x =$\frac{\pi}{2}$， 因此g (t)有最大值4；亦即f (x)有最大值4
②當t =$\sqrt{2}$時，此時可解出x =$\frac{\pi}{4}$， 因此g (t)有最小值1 + 2$\sqrt{2}$；亦即f (x)有最小值1 + 2$\sqrt{2}$
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：已知0 ≤ x < 2π ﹐求函數f (x) = (1 − si
questions.question_text: 已知0 ≤ x < 2π ﹐求函數f (x) = (1 − sinx)(1 − cosx)的最大值與最小值﹒
questions.explanation_text:
將函數f (x)展開得到f (x) = (1 − sinx)(1 − cosx) = 1 − (sinx + cosx) + sinxcosx﹒
令t = sinx + cosx﹐則t^2^ = (sinx + cosx)^2^ = 1 + 2sinxcosx⇒$\sin x\cos x = \frac{t^{2} - 1}{2}$﹒
因此﹐$f(x) = 1 - t + \frac{t^{2} - 1}{2} = \frac{1}{2}t^{2} - t + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{2}(t - 1)^{2}$﹒
因為$t = \sqrt{2}\sin(x + 45{^\circ})$﹐所以$- \sqrt{2} \leq t \leq \sqrt{2}$﹒
故①當t = 1時﹐f (x)有最小值0﹒
②當$t = - \sqrt{2}$時﹐f
(x)有最大值$\frac{1}{2}( - \sqrt{2} - 1)^{2} = \frac{3 + 2\sqrt{2}}{2}$﹒
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.question_text:

questions.title: f (x) =$\frac{\sin x}{1 - \sin x
questions.question_text: f (x) =$\frac{\sin x}{1 - \sin x}$，0$\leq$x≤$\frac{\pi}{4}$的最大值為＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
令y =$\frac{\sin x}{1 - \sin x}$ ∴ y sinx + sinx = y ⇒ sinx =$\frac{y}{y + 1}$
∵ 0 ≤ x ≤$\frac{\pi}{4}$ ⇒ 0 ≤ sinx ≤$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$
⇒ 0 ≤$\frac{y}{y + 1}$≤$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ （∵ 1 ≥ 1 − sinx ≥ 1 −$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ > 0 ⇒ y + 1=$\frac{1}{1 - \sin x}$> 0）
⇒ 0 ≤ y ≤$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ (y + 1) ⇒ 0 ≤ y ≤$\sqrt{2}$+ 1
∴ 最大值為$\sqrt{2}$+ 1
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：函數f (x) =$\frac{2\cos x}{3 + \si
questions.question_text: 函數f (x) =$\frac{2\cos x}{3 + \sin x}$的最大值為＿＿＿＿，最小值為＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
令k =$\frac{2\cos x}{3 + \sin x}$ ∴ k(3 + sinx) = 2cosx $\Rightarrow$ 3k = 2cosx − ksinx 因為x為任意實數，由重點2可知： |3k| ≤$\sqrt{2^{2} + ( - k)^{2}}$ $\Leftrightarrow$ 9k^2^ ≤ 4 + k^2\^
∴ 8k^2^ ≤ 4 ⇒ k^2^ ≤$\frac{1}{2}$ 所以 −$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$≤ k ≤$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$，故最大值為$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$，而最小值為 −$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：設x為實數﹐試求$\frac{2 + \cos x}{2 +
questions.question_text: 設x為實數﹐試求$\frac{2 + \cos x}{2 + \sin x}$的最大值與最小值﹒
questions.explanation_text: 令$y = \frac{2 + \cos x}{2 + \sin x}$⇒ 2y + ysinx = 2 + cosx ⇒ 2y − 2 = cosx − ysinx $$- \sqrt{1 + y^{2}} \leq \cos x - y\sin x \leq \sqrt{1 + y^{2}} \Rightarrow - \sqrt{1 + y^{2}} \leq 2y - 2 \leq \sqrt{1 + y^{2}} \Rightarrow |\frac{2y - 2}{\sqrt{1 + y^{2}}}| \leq 1 \Rightarrow (2y - 2)^{2} \leq 1 + y^{2}$$⇒ 4y^2^ − 8y + 4 ≤ 1 + y^2^ ⇒ 3y^2^ − 8y + 3 ≤ 0 $$\Rightarrow \frac{4 - \sqrt{7}}{3} \leq y \leq \frac{4 + \sqrt{7}}{3} $$∴最大值為$\frac{4 + \sqrt{7}}{3}$﹐最小值為$\frac{4 - \sqrt{7}}{3}$﹒
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合
tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 設$0 \leq \theta \leq \frac{\pi}{
questions.question_text:
設$0 \leq \theta \leq \frac{\pi}{2}$﹐f
(θ ) = sinθ (sinθ + cosθ )﹐求﹕(1)f (θ )之最大值﹐此時θ 之值﹒
(2)f (θ )之最小值﹐此時θ 之值﹒
questions.explanation_text:
$f(\theta) = \sin^{2}\theta + \sin\theta\cos\theta = \frac{1 - \cos 2\theta}{2} + \frac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(\sin 2\theta - \cos 2\theta) + \frac{1}{2}$ $= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin 2\theta - \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cos 2\theta) + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin(2\theta - \frac{\pi}{4}) + \frac{1}{2}$
∵$0 \leq \theta \leq \frac{\pi}{2} \Rightarrow 0 \leq 2\theta \leq \pi \Rightarrow - \frac{\pi}{4} \leq 2\theta - \frac{\pi}{4} \leq \frac{3\pi}{4}$
(1)當$2\theta - \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2}$時﹐有最大值$\frac{\sqrt{2} + 1}{2}$
∴$2\theta = \frac{3\pi}{4} \Rightarrow \theta = \frac{3\pi}{8}$﹒
(2)當$2\theta - \frac{\pi}{4} = - \frac{\pi}{4}$時﹐有最小值0﹐此時θ = 0﹒

tags: section:主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.title: 隨堂練習：設$\frac{\pi}{4}$≤ x ≤$\frac{3\pi
questions.question_text: 設$\frac{\pi}{4}$≤ x ≤$\frac{3\pi}{4}$，試求函數f (x) =$\frac{\sin x\cos x}{1 + \sin x + \cos x}$的最大值與最小值。
questions.explanation_text:
令t = sinx + cosx =\sqrt{2}．sin(x +$\frac{\pi}{4}$) ∵ $\frac{\pi}{4}$≤ x ≤$\frac{3\pi}{4}$ ∴ $\frac{\pi}{2}$≤ x +$\frac{\pi}{4}$≤ π 故0 ≤ sin(x +$\frac{\pi}{4}$) ≤ 1，亦即0 ≤ t ≤\sqrt{2}，又因為t^2^ = 1 + 2sinx．cosx，所以sinx．cosx =$\frac{t^{2} - 1}{2}$ 其次，將sinx．cosx及sinx + cosx分別用$\frac{1}{2}$ (t^2^ − 1)及t代入f (x) 令其為g (t)，則g (t) =$\frac{\frac{1}{2}(t^{2} - 1)}{1 + t}$ ∴ g (t) =$\frac{1}{2}$
(t − 1)，其中0 ≤ t ≤\sqrt{2}
(1)當t = 0時，g (t)有最小值 −$\frac{1}{2}$，亦即f (x)有最小值 −$\frac{1}{2}$
(2)當t =\sqrt{2}時，g
(t)有最大值$\frac{\sqrt{2} - 1}{2}$，亦即f (x)有最大值 $\frac{\sqrt{2} - 1}{2}$
questions.source_section: 主題1：正餘弦函數的疊合

questions.question_text:

questions.title: 若$\overline{AB} = 3$﹐$\overline{
questions.question_text:
若$\overline{AB}=3$，$\overline{BC}=7$，且$\overline{AB}$與$\overline{AQ}$的夾角為 x， 則當 x 為多少弧度時，矩形 PQRS 的周長最大？
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image19.png]
questions.explanation_text:
由題意可推得∠RBC = ∠ADP = ∠BAQ = x﹐於是矩形PQRS的周長為 $2(\overline{PQ} + \overline{QR}) = 2(7\sin x + 3\cos x + 3\sin x + 7\cos x) = 20(\sin x + \cos x)$ $= 20\sqrt{2}(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin x + \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cos x) = 20\sqrt{2}(\sin x\cos\frac{\pi}{4} + \cos x\sin\frac{\pi}{4})$ $= 20\sqrt{2}\sin(x + \frac{\pi}{4})$﹒
故當$x + \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2}$﹐即$x = \frac{\pi}{4}$時﹐矩形PQRS的周長有最大值$20\sqrt{2}$﹒
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image19.png]

questions.title: 且圓心角∠AOB = 60°﹐內接矩形PQRS以∠AOB的角平分
questions.question_text:
且圓心角∠AOB = 60°，內接矩形 PQRS 以 ∠AOB 的角平分線 $\overline{OC}$ 為對稱軸， 若連接 $\overline{OR}$，並令 ∠COR = θ，則下列哪些選項是正確的？
(1)$\overline{SR}=2\sin\theta$
(2)$\overline{PS}=\cos\theta-\sqrt{3}\sin\theta$
(3)矩形 PQRS 的面積為 $\sin(2\theta)+\sqrt{3}\cos(2\theta)-\sqrt{3}$
(4)當 θ = 15° 時，矩形 PQRS 的面積有最大值
(5)矩形 PQRS 的面積最大值為 $2-\sqrt{3}$。
questions.explanation_text:
∵矩形 PQRS 以 OC 為對稱軸，故 ∠COR = ∠COS = θ，且 ∠AOC = ∠BOC = 30°。
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image21.png]
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s3-1-4/image22.png]
(1) SR = 2sinθ。
(2) PS = cosθ − √3sinθ。
(3) 矩形面積 = PS·PQ = (cosθ − √3sinθ)(2sinθ) = sin2θ + √3cos2θ − √3。
(4)(5) 又 0° < θ < 30°，當 2θ + 60° = 90°，即 θ = 15° 時，面積有最大值 2 − √3。
故選(1)(2)(3)(4)(5)。
